why: An arXiv preprint by Lingzhong Zeng (Aug 2025, 2508.06123) claims a full proof that the first eigenvalue of an embedded compact minimal hypersurface in the unit sphere equals n, directly resolving the stated conjecture; a later 2025/2026 preprint (2606.10962) still frames the conjecture as open and gives an improved partial lower bound, suggesting the claimed proof's status is unsettled.
